assertions.statement: The dashboard shows the live payroll: treasury balances, the cost of the next run in HBAR and how many runs the treasury covers.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /. The Treasury card shows a CCIP-BnM balance, an HBAR balance, a cost per run (tokens plus CCIP fees in HBAR) and 'covers N runs'.

assertions.statement: The Schedule card shows the next run, a live countdown and the pending Hedera Schedule Service entity.
assertions.howToVerify: On /, the Schedule card says the payroll is running, shows the next run time with a countdown, and links the pending schedule to hashscan.io/testnet/schedule/0.0.N.

assertions.statement: Run history lists each run, whether the Hedera Schedule Service executed it, and every payout with its CCIP message and delivery status.
assertions.howToVerify: Scroll to Run history. Run #1 is marked as executed by the Hedera Schedule Service and lists a Hedera payout and an Ethereum Sepolia payout whose CCIP message links to ccip.chain.link/msg/<id> with a status.

assertions.statement: A payee page lists every payout an address received, across chains.
assertions.howToVerify: Open /payee/0xad7B4939Fe1d6ee776FB9Effc541351608752A4E. Its OP Sepolia payouts are listed with amounts, CCIP status and destination links.

assertions.statement: Any connected wallet can top up the treasury with CCIP-BnM from the public faucet.
assertions.howToVerify: Connect the burner wallet and fund it with testnet HBAR (the harness's Tier 3.5 signer, or 'Get testnet HBAR'), click 'Add 1 CCIP-BnM' on the Treasury card and confirm. The CCIP-BnM balance rises by 1 after the transaction.
